situation.whoThisIs: An aesthetic or cosmetic clinic operated as a Grom Digital client account. The clinic treats patients; Grom runs the acquisition system on its behalf.
situation.howLeadsArrive: Meta lead-form ads and clinic landing pages, feeding an AI-handled conversation that books consultations.
situation.whatIsSold: Aesthetic treatments and consultations, typically with a deposit taken to hold the appointment.
situation.theFunnel: enquiry -> conversation -> booked consultation -> attended -> treatment decision -> paid treatment
situation.objective: Booked consultations that attend and convert into paid treatment, judged on revenue per enquiry.
knownDataCaveats: Opportunity `monetaryValue` is the revenue basis, never the payments surface. Where it is unset revenue is UNMEASURABLE rather than zero.
This system is DESIGNED to handle leads with automation and AI. Inserting a human is not a generic fix and must be argued from the evidence.
